-module(bmscl_experimental_runtime_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

-define(SECRET, <<"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef">>).

dispatcher_unavailable_fails_closed_test() ->
    with_runtime([phoenix_v1], undefined, fun() ->
        ?assertEqual(
           {error, {firecracker_runtime_dispatcher_unavailable, invoke_async}},
           bmscl_experimental_runtime:invoke_async(
             request_target(), req, tenant_ctx()))
    end).

microvm_tenant_is_required_before_dispatch_test() ->
    with_runtime([phoenix_v1], bmscl_experimental_runtime_test_dispatcher, fun() ->
        ?assertEqual(
           {error, microvm_tenant_required},
           bmscl_experimental_runtime:invoke_async(
             request_target(), request, #{}))
    end).

configured_dispatcher_receives_signed_firecracker_work_test() ->
    with_runtime(all, bmscl_experimental_runtime_test_dispatcher, fun() ->
        RequestTarget = request_target(),
        {ok, {external_invoke, RoutedRequestTarget, request, Context}} =
            bmscl_experimental_runtime:invoke_async(
              RequestTarget, request, tenant_ctx()),
        ?assertEqual(tenant_ctx(), Context),
        ?assertMatch(
           {ok, _},
           bmscl_execution_policy:admit_microvm(
             RoutedRequestTarget, invoke_async, <<"tenant-a">>)),

        ConnectionTarget = connection_target(),
        {ok, {external_connection, RoutedConnectionTarget, _Pid, _Context}} =
            bmscl_experimental_runtime:register_connection(
              ConnectionTarget, self(), tenant_ctx()),
        ?assertMatch(
           {ok, _},
           bmscl_execution_policy:admit_microvm(
             RoutedConnectionTarget, register_connection, <<"tenant-a">>)),

        %% Durable dispatch still additionally requires an immutable admitted
        %% deployment contract; a hand-crafted profile alone is not enough.
        ?assertEqual(
           {error, durable_deployment_id_required},
           bmscl_experimental_runtime:locate_durable_actor(
             durable_target(), <<"tenant-a">>, <<"a">>, <<"o">>))
    end).

disabled_durable_profile_never_reaches_dispatcher_test() ->
    with_runtime([], bmscl_experimental_runtime_test_dispatcher, fun() ->
        ?assertEqual(
           {error, {experimental_profile_disabled, durable_actor_v1}},
           bmscl_experimental_runtime:locate_durable_actor(
             durable_target(), <<"tenant-a">>, <<"a">>, <<"o">>))
    end).

invalid_direct_target_fails_before_dispatch_test() ->
    with_runtime(all, bmscl_experimental_runtime_test_dispatcher, fun() ->
        ?assertMatch(
           {error, {invalid_experimental_target, durable_actor, _}},
           bmscl_experimental_runtime:locate_durable_actor(
             #{execution_class => durable_actor,
               experimental_profile => durable_actor_v1,
               protocol => http,
               namespace => <<"rooms/invalid">>,
               isolation_class => firecracker},
             <<"tenant-a">>, <<"a">>, <<"o">>))
    end).

invalid_dispatcher_fails_closed_test() ->
    with_runtime([phoenix_v1], definitely_missing_bmscl_dispatcher, fun() ->
        ?assertMatch(
           {error, {invalid_firecracker_runtime_dispatcher,
                    definitely_missing_bmscl_dispatcher, _}},
           bmscl_experimental_runtime:invoke_async(
             request_target(), request, tenant_ctx()))
    end).

missing_signing_secret_fails_closed_test() ->
    PreviousSecret = application:get_env(
                       bmscl_supervisor, microvm_contract_secret),
    application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, microvm_contract_secret),
    try
        PreviousProfiles = application:get_env(
                             bmscl_supervisor, experimental_faas_profiles),
        application:set_env(
          bmscl_supervisor, experimental_faas_profiles, [phoenix_v1]),
        try
            ?assertEqual(
               {error, microvm_contract_secret_unavailable},
               bmscl_experimental_runtime:invoke_async(
                 request_target(), request, tenant_ctx()))
        after
            restore(experimental_faas_profiles, PreviousProfiles)
        end
    after
        restore(microvm_contract_secret, PreviousSecret)
    end.

request_target() ->
    #{execution_class => request,
      experimental_profile => phoenix_v1,
      protocol => http,
      isolation_class => firecracker}.

connection_target() ->
    #{execution_class => connection,
      experimental_profile => phoenix_v1,
      protocol => websocket,
      drain_timeout_ms => 30000,
      isolation_class => firecracker}.

durable_target() ->
    #{execution_class => durable_actor,
      experimental_profile => durable_actor_v1,
      protocol => http,
      namespace => <<"rooms">>,
      virtual_shards => 4096,
      shards_per_actor => 64,
      isolation_class => firecracker}.

tenant_ctx() ->
    #{tenant_id => <<"tenant-a">>}.

with_runtime(Profiles, Dispatcher, Fun) ->
    PreviousDispatcher = application:get_env(
                           bmscl_supervisor, experimental_runtime_dispatcher_module),
    PreviousProfiles = application:get_env(
                         bmscl_supervisor, experimental_faas_profiles),
    PreviousSecret = application:get_env(
                       bmscl_supervisor, microvm_contract_secret),
    case Dispatcher of
        undefined ->
            application:unset_env(
              bmscl_supervisor, experimental_runtime_dispatcher_module);
        _ ->
            application:set_env(
              bmscl_supervisor, experimental_runtime_dispatcher_module, Dispatcher)
    end,
    application:set_env(
      bmscl_supervisor, experimental_faas_profiles, Profiles),
    application:set_env(
      bmscl_supervisor, microvm_contract_secret, ?SECRET),
    try Fun()
    after
        restore(experimental_runtime_dispatcher_module, PreviousDispatcher),
        restore(experimental_faas_profiles, PreviousProfiles),
        restore(microvm_contract_secret, PreviousSecret)
    end.

restore(Key, {ok, Value}) ->
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key, Value);
restore(Key, undefined) ->
    application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key).

-module(bmscl_faas_profile_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

default_lambda_profile_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(
       {ok, #{}},
       bmscl_faas_profile:normalize(#{})).

phoenix_request_is_still_faas_request_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(
       {ok, #{execution_class => request,
              experimental_profile => phoenix_v1,
              protocol => http,
              isolation_class => firecracker}},
       bmscl_faas_profile:normalize(#{
           <<"experimental_profile">> => <<"phoenix_v1">>,
           <<"execution_class">> => <<"request">>,
           <<"protocol">> => <<"http">>
       })).

phoenix_connection_profile_test() ->
    {ok, Profile} = bmscl_faas_profile:normalize(#{
        execution_class => connection,
        experimental_profile => phoenix_v1,
        protocol => websocket
    }),
    ?assertEqual(connection, maps:get(execution_class, Profile)),
    ?assertEqual(firecracker, maps:get(isolation_class, Profile)),
    ?assertEqual(30000, maps:get(drain_timeout_ms, Profile)).

connection_requires_experimental_profile_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, {experimental_profile_required, connection}},
       bmscl_faas_profile:normalize(#{
           execution_class => connection,
           protocol => websocket
       })).

durable_actor_layout_is_normalized_test() ->
    {ok, Profile} = bmscl_faas_profile:normalize(#{
        execution_class => durable_actor,
        experimental_profile => durable_actor_v1,
        namespace => <<"rooms">>
    }),
    ?assertEqual(4096, maps:get(virtual_shards, Profile)),
    ?assertEqual(64, maps:get(shards_per_actor, Profile)),
    ?assertEqual(firecracker, maps:get(isolation_class, Profile)).

durable_actor_rejects_invalid_namespace_and_layout_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, invalid_durable_namespace},
       bmscl_faas_profile:normalize(#{
           execution_class => durable_actor,
           experimental_profile => durable_actor_v1,
           namespace => <<"rooms/escape">>
       })),
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, invalid_virtual_shards},
       bmscl_faas_profile:normalize(#{
           execution_class => durable_actor,
           experimental_profile => durable_actor_v1,
           namespace => <<"rooms">>,
           virtual_shards => 1
       })),
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, invalid_shards_per_actor},
       bmscl_faas_profile:normalize(#{
           execution_class => durable_actor,
           experimental_profile => durable_actor_v1,
           namespace => <<"rooms">>,
           virtual_shards => 8192,
           shards_per_actor => 8192
       })).

experimental_profiles_require_firecracker_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, {experimental_profile_requires_firecracker,
                phoenix_v1, bare_process}},
       bmscl_faas_profile:normalize(#{
           execution_class => request,
           experimental_profile => phoenix_v1,
           protocol => http,
           isolation_class => bare_process
       })),
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, {experimental_profile_requires_firecracker,
                durable_actor_v1, bare_process}},
       bmscl_faas_profile:normalize(#{
           execution_class => durable_actor,
           experimental_profile => durable_actor_v1,
           namespace => <<"rooms">>,
           isolation_class => <<"bare_process">>
       })).

experimental_profile_gate_test() ->
    Previous = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, experimental_faas_profiles),
    try
        application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, experimental_faas_profiles, []),
        ?assertEqual(
           {error, {experimental_profile_disabled, phoenix_v1}},
           bmscl_faas_profile:ensure_enabled(#{experimental_profile => phoenix_v1})),
        application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, experimental_faas_profiles, [phoenix_v1]),
        ?assertEqual(
           ok,
           bmscl_faas_profile:ensure_enabled(#{experimental_profile => phoenix_v1}))
    after
        restore_env(Previous)
    end.

restore_env(undefined) ->
    application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, experimental_faas_profiles);
restore_env({ok, Value}) ->
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, experimental_faas_profiles, Value).

-module(bmscl_guest_protocol_tests).
-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

normalizes_sha256_prefix_test() ->
    Digest = <<"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa">>,
    ?assertEqual(Digest, bmscl_guest_protocol:normalize_deployment_id(<<"sha256:", Digest/binary>>)),
    ?assertEqual(Digest, bmscl_guest_protocol:normalize_deployment_id(Digest)).

decodes_invocation_envelope_test() ->
    Digest = <<"bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb">>,
    Frame = jsx:encode(#{
        <<"op">> => <<"invoke">>,
        <<"invocation_id">> => <<"inv-1">>,
        <<"deployment_id">> => <<"sha256:", Digest/binary>>,
        <<"request">> => #{<<"method">> => <<"GET">>, <<"path">> => <<"/">>},
        <<"context">> => #{<<"trace_id">> => <<"trace-1">>},
        <<"capability_refs">> => [
            #{<<"name">> => <<"ctx.fetch">>, <<"token_ref">> => <<"cap-token-1">>}
        ],
        <<"timeout_ms">> => 5000
    }),
    {ok, Decoded} = bmscl_guest_protocol:decode_request(Frame),
    ?assertEqual(invoke, maps:get(op, Decoded)),
    ?assertEqual(Digest, maps:get(deployment_id, Decoded)),
    ?assertEqual(5000, maps:get(timeout_ms, Decoded)),
    ?assertEqual(<<"inv-1">>, maps:get(invocation_id, Decoded)),
    ?assertEqual(
       [#{<<"name">> => <<"ctx.fetch">>, <<"token_ref">> => <<"cap-token-1">>}],
       maps:get(capability_refs, Decoded)).

decodes_digest_only_activation_envelope_test() ->
    Digest = <<"dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd">>,
    Frame = jsx:encode(#{
        <<"op">> => <<"activate_artifact">>,
        <<"deployment_id">> => <<"sha256:", Digest/binary>>
    }),
    ?assertEqual(
       {ok, #{op => activate_artifact, deployment_id => Digest}},
       bmscl_guest_protocol:decode_request(Frame)).

rejects_path_like_activation_identity_test() ->
    Frame = jsx:encode(#{
        <<"op">> => <<"activate_artifact">>,
        <<"deployment_id">> => <<"../../tmp/worker">>
    }),
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, invalid_activation_envelope},
       bmscl_guest_protocol:decode_request(Frame)).

artifact_path_is_derived_only_from_trusted_root_and_digest_test() ->
    Digest = <<"eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee">>,
    ?assertEqual(
       {ok, "/var/lib/beamscale/artifacts/eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee"},
       bmscl_guest_artifact:artifact_path("/var/lib/beamscale/artifacts", Digest)),
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, invalid_guest_artifact_root},
       bmscl_guest_artifact:artifact_path("relative/artifacts", Digest)),
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, invalid_deployment_id},
       bmscl_guest_artifact:artifact_path("/var/lib/beamscale/artifacts", <<"../escape">>)).

encodes_activation_result_test() ->
    Digest = <<"ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff">>,
    Success = jsx:decode(bmscl_guest_protocol:encode_activation_result(Digest, ok), [return_maps]),
    ?assertEqual(true, maps:get(<<"ok">>, Success)),
    ?assertEqual(Digest, maps:get(<<"active_deployment_id">>, Success)),
    Failure = jsx:decode(
        bmscl_guest_protocol:encode_activation_result(Digest, {error, rejected}),
        [return_maps]),
    ?assertEqual(false, maps:get(<<"ok">>, Failure)),
    ?assertEqual(
       rejected,
       binary_to_term(base64:decode(maps:get(<<"error_etf_base64">>, Failure)), [safe])).

accepts_platform_timeout_ceiling_test() ->
    Digest = <<"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa">>,
    Frame = jsx:encode(#{
        <<"op">> => <<"invoke">>,
        <<"deployment_id">> => Digest,
        <<"request">> => #{},
        <<"context">> => #{},
        <<"timeout_ms">> => 90000
    }),
    {ok, Decoded} = bmscl_guest_protocol:decode_request(Frame),
    ?assertEqual(90000, maps:get(timeout_ms, Decoded)).

rejects_timeout_above_platform_ceiling_test() ->
    Digest = <<"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa">>,
    Frame = jsx:encode(#{
        <<"op">> => <<"invoke">>,
        <<"deployment_id">> => Digest,
        <<"request">> => #{},
        <<"context">> => #{},
        <<"timeout_ms">> => 90001
    }),
    ?assertEqual({error, invalid_invocation_envelope}, bmscl_guest_protocol:decode_request(Frame)).

rejects_duplicate_capability_refs_test() ->
    Digest = <<"cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc">>,
    Ref = #{<<"name">> => <<"ctx.fetch">>, <<"token_ref">> => <<"one">>},
    Frame = jsx:encode(#{
        <<"op">> => <<"invoke">>,
        <<"deployment_id">> => Digest,
        <<"request">> => #{},
        <<"context">> => #{},
        <<"capability_refs">> => [Ref, Ref]
    }),
    ?assertEqual({error, invalid_invocation_envelope}, bmscl_guest_protocol:decode_request(Frame)).

capability_refs_must_be_admitted_test() ->
    Refs = [#{<<"name">> => <<"ctx.fetch">>, <<"token_ref">> => <<"one">>}],
    ?assertEqual(ok, bmscl_guest_protocol:validate_capability_refs(Refs, [<<"ctx.fetch">>])),
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, {capability_not_admitted, [<<"ctx.fetch">>]}},
       bmscl_guest_protocol:validate_capability_refs(Refs, [<<"ctx.kv">>])).

encodes_arbitrary_erlang_term_as_etf_test() ->
    Value = {gleam_record, 42, [ok, <<"bytes">>]},
    Reply = jsx:decode(bmscl_guest_protocol:encode_result(<<"inv-2">>, {ok, Value}), [return_maps]),
    ?assertEqual(true, maps:get(<<"ok">>, Reply)),
    Encoded = maps:get(<<"payload_etf_base64">>, Reply),
    Payload = base64:decode(Encoded),
    ?assertEqual(Value, binary_to_term(Payload, [safe])),
    ?assertEqual(byte_size(Payload), maps:get(<<"payload_etf_bytes">>, Reply)).

encodes_invocation_metrics_test() ->
    Digest = <<"abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab">>,
    Metrics = #{wall_time_ms => 17,
                reductions => 1234,
                output_bytes => 42,
                executed_digest => Digest,
                termination_reason => reductions},
    Reply = jsx:decode(
        bmscl_guest_protocol:encode_result(<<"inv-3">>, {error, budget}, Metrics),
        [return_maps]),
    ?assertEqual(17, maps:get(<<"wall_time_ms">>, Reply)),
    ?assertEqual(1234, maps:get(<<"reductions">>, Reply)),
    ?assertEqual(42, maps:get(<<"output_bytes">>, Reply)),
    ?assertEqual(Digest, maps:get(<<"executed_digest">>, Reply)),
    ?assertEqual(<<"reductions">>, maps:get(<<"termination_reason">>, Reply)),
    ErrorPayload = base64:decode(maps:get(<<"error_etf_base64">>, Reply)),
    ?assertEqual(byte_size(ErrorPayload), maps:get(<<"error_etf_bytes">>, Reply)).

invalid_executed_digest_is_not_reflected_test() ->
    Reply = jsx:decode(
        bmscl_guest_protocol:encode_result(
          <<"inv-4">>,
          {ok, ok},
          #{executed_digest => <<"not-a-digest">>, output_bytes => -1}),
        [return_maps]),
    ?assertEqual(<<>>, maps:get(<<"executed_digest">>, Reply)),
    ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(<<"output_bytes">>, Reply)).

-module(bmscl_host_log_test_sink).

-export([emit/3]).

emit(Level, Message, Meta) ->
    erlang:put(bmscl_host_log_test_event, {Level, Message, Meta}),
    ok.

-module(bmscl_host_log_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

valid_log_capability_emits_sanitized_bounded_event_test() ->
    with_test_sink(fun() ->
        Capability = log_capability(#{
            <<"invocation_id">> => <<"inv-1">>,
            <<"tenant_id">> => <<"tenant-7">>,
            <<"secret">> => <<"must-not-leak">>
        }),
        ?assertEqual(nil, bmscl_host_log:write(Capability, <<"info">>, <<"hello\r\nworld">>)),
        {info, Message, Meta} = erlang:get(bmscl_host_log_test_event),
        ?assertEqual(<<"hello  world">>, Message),
        ?assertEqual(<<"inv-1">>, maps:get(<<"invocation_id">>, Meta)),
        ?assertEqual(<<"tenant-7">>, maps:get(<<"tenant_id">>, Meta)),
        ?assertEqual(false, maps:is_key(<<"secret">>, Meta))
    end).

cross_process_capability_replay_is_rejected_test() ->
    with_test_sink(fun() ->
        Capability = log_capability(#{}),
        Parent = self(),
        spawn(fun() ->
            Parent ! {result, catch bmscl_host_log:write(Capability, <<"info">>, <<"nope">>)}
        end),
        receive
            {result, {'EXIT', {{bmscl_capability_denied, capability_not_admitted}, _}}} -> ok;
            {result, Other} -> ?assertEqual(expected_capability_denial, Other)
        after 1000 ->
            ?assert(false)
        end
    end).

invalid_level_is_rejected_before_sink_test() ->
    with_test_sink(fun() ->
        Capability = log_capability(#{}),
        ?assertError(
            {invalid_log_level, <<"fatal">>},
            bmscl_host_log:write(Capability, <<"fatal">>, <<"message">>)
        ),
        ?assertEqual(undefined, erlang:get(bmscl_host_log_test_event))
    end).

oversized_message_is_rejected_before_sink_test() ->
    with_test_sink(fun() ->
        Capability = log_capability(#{}),
        Message = binary:copy(<<"x">>, 8193),
        ?assertError(
            {log_message_too_large, 8193, 8192},
            bmscl_host_log:write(Capability, <<"info">>, Message)
        ),
        ?assertEqual(undefined, erlang:get(bmscl_host_log_test_event))
    end).

wrong_capability_shape_is_rejected_test() ->
    with_test_sink(fun() ->
        ?assertError(
            {bmscl_capability_denied, invalid_capability_shape},
            bmscl_host_log:write({http_capability, <<"forged">>}, <<"info">>, <<"message">>)
        )
    end).

log_capability(ExtraMeta) ->
    Context0 = maps:merge(
        #{
            <<"deadline_unix_ms">> => erlang:system_time(millisecond) + 10000,
            <<"admitted_capabilities">> => [<<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"ctx.log">>],
            <<"capability_refs">> => []
        },
        ExtraMeta
    ),
    {ok, {context, _Cluster, Capability, _Deadline}} =
        bmscl_hosted_abi:context(Context0),
    Capability.

with_test_sink(Fun) ->
    Previous = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, host_log_sink_module),
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, host_log_sink_module, bmscl_host_log_test_sink),
    erlang:erase(bmscl_host_log_test_event),
    try Fun()
    after
        erlang:erase(bmscl_host_log_test_event),
        restore_env(Previous)
    end.

restore_env(undefined) -> application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, host_log_sink_module);
restore_env({ok, Value}) -> application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, host_log_sink_module, Value).

-module(bmscl_hosted_abi_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

request_conversion_test() ->
    Request0 = #{
        <<"method">> => <<"POST">>,
        <<"url">> => <<"https://example.test/items?q=1">>,
        <<"headers">> => [
            [<<"content-type">>, <<"application/octet-stream">>],
            [<<"x-request-id">>, <<"abc">>]
        ],
        <<"body_base64">> => base64:encode(<<0, 1, 2, 255>>)
    },
    ?assertEqual(
       {ok, {request,
             <<"POST">>,
             <<"https://example.test/items?q=1">>,
             [{<<"content-type">>, <<"application/octet-stream">>},
              {<<"x-request-id">>, <<"abc">>}],
             <<0, 1, 2, 255>>}},
       bmscl_hosted_abi:request(Request0)).

path_is_accepted_as_url_compatibility_test() ->
    Request0 = #{<<"method">> => <<"GET">>, <<"path">> => <<"/hello">>},
    ?assertEqual(
       {ok, {request, <<"GET">>, <<"/hello">>, [], <<>>}},
       bmscl_hosted_abi:request(Request0)).

context_constructs_exact_read_only_sdk_shape_test() ->
    Deadline = erlang:system_time(millisecond) + 10000,
    Context0 = base_context(Deadline),
    {ok, {context, Cluster, Log, Deadline}} = bmscl_hosted_abi:context(Context0),
    ?assertMatch({cluster_capability, _}, Cluster),
    ?assertMatch({log_capability, _}, Log),
    ?assertMatch({ok, _}, bmscl_hosted_abi:authorize(<<"ctx.cluster">>, Cluster)),
    ?assertMatch({ok, _}, bmscl_hosted_abi:authorize(<<"ctx.log">>, Log)).

context_rejects_mutable_or_ambient_capability_names_test() ->
    Deadline = erlang:system_time(millisecond) + 10000,
    lists:foreach(fun(Name) ->
        Context0 = (base_context(Deadline))#{
            <<"admitted_capabilities">> => [<<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"ctx.log">>, Name]
        },
        ?assertEqual({error, invalid_admitted_capabilities},
                     bmscl_hosted_abi:validate_wire(
                       #{<<"method">> => <<"GET">>, <<"path">> => <<"/">>},
                       Context0))
    end, [<<"ctx.http">>, <<"ctx.kv">>, <<"ctx.env">>, <<"ctx.secrets">>,
          <<"ctx.databases">>, <<"ctx.queues">>]).

capability_token_is_process_local_test() ->
    Context0 = base_context(erlang:system_time(millisecond) + 10000),
    {ok, {context, Cluster, _Log, _Deadline}} = bmscl_hosted_abi:context(Context0),
    ?assertMatch({ok, _}, bmscl_hosted_abi:authorize(<<"ctx.cluster">>, Cluster)),
    Parent = self(),
    spawn(fun() ->
        Parent ! {cross_process_auth,
                  bmscl_hosted_abi:authorize(<<"ctx.cluster">>, Cluster)}
    end),
    receive
        {cross_process_auth, Result} -> ?assertEqual({error, capability_not_admitted}, Result)
    after 1000 ->
        ?assert(false)
    end.

wire_validation_rejects_non_core_ref_test() ->
    Request0 = #{<<"method">> => <<"GET">>, <<"path">> => <<"/">>},
    Context0 = (base_context(erlang:system_time(millisecond) + 10000))#{
        <<"capability_refs">> => [

-module(bmscl_http_capability_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

v3_http_capability_is_scoped_and_process_local_test() ->
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, http_provider_module, bmscl_http_test_provider),
    try
        Grant = http_grant(),
        Context0 = #{
            <<"hosted_abi_version">> => <<"bmscl.hosted-gleam.v3-http-capability">>,
            <<"admitted_capabilities">> => [<<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"ctx.http">>, <<"ctx.log">>],
            <<"admitted_capability_grants">> => [cluster_grant(), Grant, log_grant()],
            <<"capability_refs">> => [],
            <<"deadline_unix_ms">> => erlang:system_time(millisecond) + 5000
        },
        ok = bmscl_capability_scope:install(Context0),
        {ok, _Request, {http_context, _Cluster, Http, _Log, _Deadline}} =
            bmscl_hosted_abi:prepare(request(), Context0),
        ok = handoff_test_authority(),
        ?assertEqual(undefined, erlang:get({bmscl_capability_scope, grants})),
        ?assertEqual(undefined, erlang:get({bmscl_hosted_abi, allowed})),
        ?assertEqual(undefined, erlang:get({bmscl_hosted_abi, tokens})),
        ?assertEqual(undefined, erlang:get({bmscl_hosted_abi, meta})),
        ?assertMatch(
            {ok, {response, 200, _, <<"hello">>}},
            bmscl_host_http:request(
              Http, <<"POST">>, <<"https://api.example.com/v1">>,
              [{<<"content-type">>, <<"text/plain">>}], <<"hello">>)),
        ?assertEqual(
            {error, <<"http_origin_denied">>},
            bmscl_host_http:request(
              Http, <<"GET">>, <<"https://other.example.com/v1">>, [], <<>>)),
        lists:foreach(fun(PrivateUrl) ->
            ?assertEqual(
                {error, <<"http_origin_denied">>},
                bmscl_host_http:request(Http, <<"GET">>, PrivateUrl, [], <<>>))
        end, [
            <<"https://127.0.0.1/">>,
            <<"https://169.254.169.254/">>,
            <<"https://[::1]/">>,
            <<"https://metadata.google.internal/">>
        ]),
        ?assertEqual(
            {error, <<"http_header_denied">>},
            bmscl_host_http:request(
              Http, <<"GET">>, <<"https://api.example.com/v1">>,
              [{<<"host">>, <<"evil.example">>}], <<>>)),
        Parent = self(),
        Pid = spawn(fun() ->
            Parent ! {child_result, bmscl_host_http:request(
                Http, <<"GET">>, <<"https://api.example.com/v1">>, [], <<>>)}
        end),
        Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Pid),
        receive
            {child_result, Result} ->
                ?assertEqual({error, <<"http_capability_denied">>}, Result)
        after 1000 -> ?assert(false)
        end,
        receive {'DOWN', Mon, process, Pid, normal} -> ok after 1000 -> ?assert(false) end
    after
        application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, http_provider_module),
        stop_test_broker()
    end.

handoff_test_authority() ->
    Grants = erlang:get({bmscl_capability_scope, grants}),
    Allowed = erlang:get({bmscl_hosted_abi, allowed}),
    Tokens = erlang:get({bmscl_hosted_abi, tokens}),
    Meta = erlang:get({bmscl_hosted_abi, meta}),
    ok = bmscl_authority_broker:install_grants(self(), Grants),
    ok = bmscl_authority_broker:install_abi(self(), Allowed, Tokens, Meta),
    _ = erlang:erase({bmscl_capability_scope, grants}),
    _ = erlang:erase({bmscl_capability_ref, refs}),
    _ = erlang:erase({bmscl_hosted_abi, allowed}),
    _ = erlang:erase({bmscl_hosted_abi, tokens}),
    _ = erlang:erase({bmscl_hosted_abi, meta}),
    ok.

stop_test_broker() ->
    case whereis(bmscl_authority_broker) of
        undefined -> ok;
        Pid when is_pid(Pid) ->
            Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Pid),
            _ = gen_server:stop(Pid, normal, 1000),
            receive
                {'DOWN', Mon, process, Pid, _Reason} -> ok
            after 1000 -> error(authority_broker_did_not_stop)
            end
    end.

with_manager(MaxInflight, Fun) ->
    ?assertEqual(undefined, whereis(bmscl_http_request_manager)),
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, http_request_client_module,
                        bmscl_http_test_client),
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, http_test_owner, self()),
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, max_http_inflight_requests, MaxInflight),
    {ok, Manager} = bmscl_http_request_manager:start_link(),
    unlink(Manager),
    try
        Fun()
    after
        case whereis(bmscl_http_request_manager) of
            undefined -> ok;
            Pid -> catch gen_server:stop(Pid)
        end,
        application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, http_request_client_module),
        application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, http_test_owner),
        application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, max_http_inflight_requests),
        flush_test_messages()
    end.

flush_test_messages() ->
    receive
        {http_test_cancel, _} -> flush_test_messages();
        {caller1, _} -> flush_test_messages();
        {caller2, _} -> flush_test_messages();
        {ignored, _} -> flush_test_messages()
    after 0 ->
        ok
    end.

-module(bmscl_http_router_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

pinned_http_routing_test_() ->
    {setup,
     fun setup/0,
     fun cleanup/1,
     fun(Root) ->
         [?_test(route_hold_prevents_gc_until_atomic_swap(Root)),
          ?_test(route_hold_does_not_block_runtime_restart(Root))]
     end}.

setup() ->
    Root = filename:join([tmp_dir(), "bmscl-http-router-eunit-" ++
                         integer_to_list(erlang:unique_integer([positive]))]),
    ok = filelib:ensure_dir(filename:join(Root, "placeholder")),
    ok = application:load(bmscl_supervisor),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, deployment_slots, 3),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, budget_tick_ms, 5),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, route_source_module, undefined),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_admission_receipt, false),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_attestation, false),
    ok = application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_trusted_build_provenance, false),
    {ok, _} = application:ensure_all_started(bmscl_supervisor),
    Root.

cleanup(Root) ->
    _ = application:stop(bmscl_supervisor),
    _ = application:unload(bmscl_supervisor),
    _ = os:cmd("rm -rf " ++ shell_quote(Root)),
    ok.

route_hold_prevents_gc_until_atomic_swap(Root) ->
    A1 = make_artifact(Root, "route_v1"),
    {ok, Id1} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(A1),
    Route1 = #{deployment_id => Id1,
               actor_path => <<"routes/get/example">>,
               entrypoint => <<"worker:handle/2">>},
    {ok, updated} = bmscl_route_table:replace_snapshot(
                      1, #{{get, "/example"} => Route1}),

    %% Activating v2 makes v1 draining. The route-table hold must keep v1 from
    %% being reclaimed before a request has a chance to pin that exact target.
    A2 = make_artifact(Root, "route_v2"),
    {ok, Id2} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(A2),
    {ok, 0} = bmscl_deployment_manager:gc(),
    ?assertMatch({ok, {route_v1, _}},
                 bmscl_http_router:invoke(<<"get">>, <<"/example">>, normal, #{}, 2000)),

    %% ANY fallback uses the same exact-generation route contract.
    {ok, updated} = bmscl_route_table:replace_snapshot(
                      2, #{{<<"ANY">>, <<"/example">>} =>
                               Route1#{actor_path => <<"routes/any/example">>}}),
    ?assertMatch({ok, {route_v1, _}},
                 bmscl_http_router:invoke(post, "/example", normal, #{}, 2000)),

    %% A snapshot cannot become visible unless every referenced generation is
    %% loaded/pinnable. Failure preserves the previous version and route table.
    {error, {route_target_unavailable, _, deployment_not_loaded}} =
        bmscl_route_table:replace_snapshot(
          3, #{{<<"GET">>, <<"/bad">>} =>
                   #{deployment_id => <<"missing-generation">>}}),
    {ok, 2, _} = bmscl_route_table:snapshot(),
    ?assertMatch({ok, {route_v1, _}},
                 bmscl_http_router:invoke(delete, <<"/example">>, normal, #{}, 2000)),

    %% Publish v2 first, then release v1. From this point GC may reclaim v1,
    %% while fresh requests resolve only the new generation.
    Route2 = Route1#{deployment_id => Id2},
    {ok, updated} = bmscl_route_table:replace_snapshot(
                      3, #{{<<"GET">>, <<"/example">>} => Route2}),
    {ok, 1} = bmscl_deployment_manager:gc(),
    ?assertMatch({ok, {route_v2, _}},
                 bmscl_http_router:invoke(get, "/example", normal, #{}, 2000)),
    ?assertEqual({error, route_not_found},
                 bmscl_http_router:resolve(post, "/example")),

    {ok, updated} = bmscl_route_table:replace_snapshot(4, #{}),
    ok.

route_hold_does_not_block_runtime_restart(Root) ->
    Artifact = make_artifact(Root, "route_restart"),
    {ok, DeploymentId} = bmscl_deployment_manager:activate_artifact(Artifact),
    Route = #{deployment_id => DeploymentId,
              actor_path => <<"routes/get/restart">>,
              entrypoint => <<"worker:handle/2">>},
    {ok, Version, _} = bmscl_route_table:snapshot(),
    {ok, updated} = bmscl_route_table:replace_snapshot(
                      Version + 1, #{{get, "/restart"} => Route}),
    ?assertMatch({ok, Route}, bmscl_route_table:resolve(get, "/restart")),
    Status = bmscl_deployment_manager:status(),
    ?assert(maps:get(pending_pins, Status) >= 1),

    Bootstrap = whereis(bmscl_sup),
    OldRuntime = whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup),
    {ok, NewRuntime} = bmscl_runtime:restart(1000),
    ?assertEqual(Bootstrap, whereis(bmscl_sup)),
    ?assert(NewRuntime =/= OldRuntime),
    ?assertEqual(NewRuntime, whereis(bmscl_runtime_sup)),
    ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(pending_pins, bmscl_deployment_manager:status())),
    ok.

make_artifact(Root, Tag) ->
    Dir = filename:join(Root, Tag),
    BeamDir = filename:join(Dir, "beam"),
    ok = filelib:ensure_dir(filename:join(BeamDir, "placeholder")),
    SourcePath = filename:join(Dir, "worker.erl"),
    Source = worker_source(Tag),
    ok = file:write_file(SourcePath, Source),
    {ok, worker, BeamBin} = compile:file(SourcePath, [binary, debug_info]),
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(BeamDir, "worker.beam"), BeamBin),

    Limits = #{max_wall_ms => 30000,
               max_reductions => 50000000,
               max_heap_bytes => 64 * 1024 * 1024,
               max_processes => 1},
    JsonLimits = #{
        <<"max_wall_ms">> => maps:get(max_wall_ms, Limits),
        <<"max_reductions">> => maps:get(max_reductions, Limits),
        <<"max_heap_bytes">> => maps:get(max_heap_bytes, Limits),
        <<"max_processes">> => maps:get(max_processes, Limits)
    },
    SourceSha = sha256_hex(Source),
    BuildSha = tree_digest([{<<"worker.beam">>, BeamBin}]),
    Manifest = #{
        <<"format_version">> => 1,
        <<"runtime">> => <<"beam">>,
        <<"language">> => <<"gleam">>,
        <<"profile">> => <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-v2-read-only">>,
        <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
        <<"build_sha256">> => BuildSha,
        <<"entrypoint">> => <<"worker:handle/2">>,
        <<"capabilities">> => core_grants(),
        <<"runtime_limits">> => JsonLimits
    },
    Admission = #{
        <<"admitted">> => true,
        <<"policy_version">> => <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-v2-read-only">>,
        <<"source_sha256">> => SourceSha,
        <<"findings">> => [],
        <<"runtime_limits">> => JsonLimits
    },
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "manifest.json"), jsx:encode(Manifest)),
    ok = file:write_file(filename:join(Dir, "admission-report.json"), jsx:encode(Admission)),
    Dir.

core_grants() ->
    [
        #{
            <<"name">> => <<"ctx.log">>,
            <<"scope">> => #{
                <<"sink">> => <<"tenant-observability">>,
                <<"application_state">> => false
            }
        },
        #{
            <<"name">> => <<"ctx.cluster">>,
            <<"scope">> => #{
                <<"transport">> => <<"http-semantics">>,
                <<"same_cluster_only">> => true,
                <<"version_affinity">> => <<"inherit">>,
                <<"methods">> => [<<"GET">>, <<"HEAD">>],
                <<"max_request_body_bytes">> => 0
            }
        }
    ].

worker_source(Tag) ->
    Atom = list_to_binary(Tag),
    <<"-module(worker).\n",
      "-export([handle/2]).\n",
      "handle(_Req, _Ctx) -> {", Atom/binary, ", self()}.\n">>.

tree_digest(Files0) ->
    Files = lists:sort(Files0),
    Ctx0 = crypto:hash_init(sha256),
    Ctx = lists:foldl(
      fun({Name, Bytes}, C0) ->
          C1 = crypto:hash_update(C0, Name),
          C2 = crypto:hash_update(C1, <<0>>),
          C3 = crypto:hash_update(C2, Bytes),
          crypto:hash_update(C3, <<0>>)
      end,
      Ctx0,
      Files),
    lower_hex(crypto:hash_final(Ctx)).

sha256_hex(Bytes) -> lower_hex(crypto:hash(sha256, Bytes)).

lower_hex(Bin) ->
    unicode:characters_to_binary(string:lowercase(binary_to_list(binary:encode_hex(Bin)))).

tmp_dir() ->
    case os:getenv("TMPDIR") of false -> "/tmp"; V -> V end.

shell_quote(S) ->
    "'" ++ string:replace(S, "'", "'\\''", all) ++ "'".

-module(bmscl_http_test_client).

-export([start_linked/0, request/6, cancel/2, stop/1]).

start_linked() ->
    Owner = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, http_test_owner, undefined),
    Pid = spawn_link(fun() -> loop(Owner, #{}) end),
    {ok, Pid}.

request(Profile, Receiver, _Method, _Request, _HttpOptions, _Options) ->
    RequestId = make_ref(),
    Profile ! {start_request, RequestId, Receiver},
    {ok, RequestId}.

cancel(Profile, RequestId) ->
    Profile ! {cancel_request, RequestId},
    ok.

stop(Profile) ->
    Profile ! stop,
    ok.

loop(Owner, Requests) ->
    receive
        {start_request, RequestId, Receiver} ->
            notify(Owner, {http_test_request, self(), RequestId, Receiver}),
            loop(Owner, maps:put(RequestId, Receiver, Requests));
        {respond, RequestId, Result} ->
            case maps:take(RequestId, Requests) of
                error ->
                    loop(Owner, Requests);
                {Receiver, Requests1} ->
                    Receiver ! {http, {RequestId, Result}},
                    loop(Owner, Requests1)
            end;
        {cancel_request, RequestId} ->
            notify(Owner, {http_test_cancel, RequestId}),
            loop(Owner, maps:remove(RequestId, Requests));
        stop ->
            exit(normal)
    end.

notify(Pid, Message) when is_pid(Pid) -> Pid ! Message;
notify(_, _) -> ok.

-module(bmscl_limits_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

heap_backstop_includes_shared_binaries_test() ->
    Backstop = bmscl_limits:heap_backstop(1024 * 1024),
    ?assertEqual(true, maps:get(kill, Backstop)),
    ?assertEqual(false, maps:get(error_logger, Backstop)),
    ?assertEqual(true, maps:get(include_shared_binaries, Backstop)),
    ?assert(maps:get(size, Backstop) > 0).

shared_binary_can_trigger_native_heap_kill_test() ->
    Parent = self(),
    Worker = spawn(fun() ->
        _ = erlang:process_flag(
              max_heap_size,
              bmscl_limits:heap_backstop(1024 * 1024)),
        Big = binary:copy(<<16#A5>>, 4 * 1024 * 1024),
        Parent ! {allocated, self(), byte_size(Big)},
        %% Keep the large ref-counted binary live and force a collection so the
        %% native max-heap check observes shared-binary virtual heap usage.
        erlang:garbage_collect(),
        receive
            stop -> byte_size(Big)
        end
    end),
    Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Worker),
    receive
        {'DOWN', Mon, process, Worker, killed} -> ok;
        {allocated, Worker, 4194304} ->
            receive
                {'DOWN', Mon, process, Worker, killed} -> ok
            after 1000 ->
                exit(Worker, kill),
                ?assert(false)
            end
    after 1000 ->
        exit(Worker, kill),
        ?assert(false)
    end.

-module(bmscl_microvm_contract_tests).

-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

-define(SECRET, <<"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef">>).

issue_and_verify_test() ->
    with_secret(fun() ->
        Target = phoenix_target(),
        {ok, Contract} =
            bmscl_microvm_contract:issue(
              invoke_async, <<"tenant-a">>, Target),
        {ok, Claims} =
            bmscl_microvm_contract:verify(
              Contract, invoke_async, <<"tenant-a">>),
        ?assertEqual(firecracker, maps:get(backend, Claims)),
        ?assertEqual(phoenix_v1, maps:get(experimental_profile, Claims)),
        ?assertEqual(<<"dep-1">>, maps:get(deployment_id, Claims)),
        Authority = maps:get(authority, Claims),
        ?assertEqual(single_tenant_microvm,
                     maps:get(tenant_isolation, Authority)),
        ?assertEqual(allowed, maps:get(beam_process_spawn, Authority)),
        ?assertEqual(denied, maps:get(os_process_spawn, Authority))
    end).

tenant_mismatch_is_rejected_test() ->
    with_secret(fun() ->
        {ok, Contract} =
            bmscl_microvm_contract:issue(
              invoke_async, <<"tenant-a">>, phoenix_target()),
        ?assertEqual(
           {error, microvm_tenant_mismatch},
           bmscl_microvm_contract:verify(
             Contract, invoke_async, <<"tenant-b">>))
    end).

operation_mismatch_is_rejected_test() ->
    with_secret(fun() ->
        {ok, Contract} =
            bmscl_microvm_contract:issue(
              invoke_async, <<"tenant-a">>, phoenix_target()),
        ?assertEqual(
           {error, microvm_operation_mismatch},
           bmscl_microvm_contract:verify(
             Contract, register_connection, <<"tenant-a">>))
    end).

tampering_is_rejected_test() ->
    with_secret(fun() ->
        {ok, Contract0} =
            bmscl_microvm_contract:issue(
              invoke_async, <<"tenant-a">>, phoenix_target()),
        Claims0 = maps:get(claims, Contract0),
        Contract = Contract0#{
            claims => Claims0#{tenant_id => <<"tenant-b">>}
        },
        ?assertEqual(
           {error, invalid_microvm_contract_signature},
           bmscl_microvm_contract:verify(
             Contract, invoke_async, <<"tenant-b">>))
    end).

worker_admission_checks_signed_tenant_test() ->
    with_secret(fun() ->
        Target0 = phoenix_target(),
        {ok, Contract} =
            bmscl_microvm_contract:issue(
              invoke_async, <<"tenant-a">>, Target0),
        Target = Target0#{microvm_contract => Contract},
        ?assertMatch(
           {ok, _},
           bmscl_execution_policy:admit_microvm(
             Target, invoke_async, <<"tenant-a">>)),
        ?assertEqual(
           {error, microvm_tenant_mismatch},
           bmscl_execution_policy:admit_microvm(
             Target, invoke_async, <<"tenant-b">>))
    end).

missing_secret_fails_closed_test() ->
    Previous = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, microvm_contract_secret),
    application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, microvm_contract_secret),
    try
        ?assertEqual(
           {error, microvm_contract_secret_unavailable},
           bmscl_microvm_contract:issue(
             invoke_async, <<"tenant-a">>, phoenix_target()))
    after
        restore(microvm_contract_secret, Previous)
    end.

tenant_context_required_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(
       {error, microvm_tenant_required},
       bmscl_microvm_contract:tenant_from_context(#{})),
    ?assertEqual(
       {ok, <<"tenant-a">>},
       bmscl_microvm_contract:tenant_from_context(
         #{<<"tenant_id">> => <<"tenant-a">>})).

phoenix_target() ->
    #{deployment_id => <<"dep-1">>,
      execution_class => request,
      experimental_profile => phoenix_v1,
      protocol => http,
      isolation_class => firecracker}.

with_secret(Fun) ->
    Previous = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, microvm_contract_secret),
    application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, microvm_contract_secret, ?SECRET),
    try Fun()
    after restore(microvm_contract_secret, Previous)
    end.

restore(Key, undefined) -> application:unset_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key);
restore(Key, {ok, Value}) -> application:set_env(bmscl_supervisor, Key, Value).
